title: Uncovering Cultural Representation Disparities in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on an image-based country identification task using the Country211 dataset across 211 countries, employing open-ended questions, multiple-choice questions with random and culturally similar distractors, and image perturbations (rotation, gray-scaling).

Prompting Vision-Language Models in five different languages (English, Hindi, Chinese, Portuguese, Spanish) to assess how the input language affects image-based country identification accuracy and interacts with cultural representation.
